summary: Repaired the revisable session aggregator using per-ID accepted revisions, gap-connected session components, atomic proposal validation, explicit monotone watermarks, and permanent finalization. Added focused regression tests for bridges, splits, lateness, sealing, revisions, and immutability.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 14 tests passed, 0 failed (2 public, 12 candidate)
limitations: Validation is local and synthetic, not an exhaustive proof; no broker, live service, or network was accessed.
Inputs are assumed well formed as specified. Arithmetic uses JavaScript Numbers, without arbitrary-precision integer support.
Components are recomputed for proposals and accepted changes; this favors clarity for the specified limit of 80 records and 18 logical IDs over large-stream optimization.
